macros.name: archive
macros.doc: \archive is shape-identical to \dir (takes a children block, accepts the same per-entry override keys) but renders its name without the trailing /.

macros.name: DirtreexFormatName

macros.name: verbarchive
macros.doc: \verbarchive is the verbatim sibling of \archive — container-shaped (children block, no trailing /), but with the path read at catcode 12.
